title: Termini W1-W6 acceptance test matrix
description: Single source of truth mapping each workstream's stated acceptance criteria to an independently runnable test with captured evidence. Criterion text is verbatim from the W1-W6 kanban cards (termini board).

evidence_format.schema: Each check writes a timestamped JSON artifact {check_id, title, timestamp_utc, command, raw_output, env} under evidence/<run_id>/. env captures {controller_url, repo_commit, controller_version_header, nodes[], lxd_containers[], collected_at_utc} so a result is reproducible from the artifact alone.
evidence_format.environment_hash: repo_commit + controller_version_header + node names/roles + image tags + lxd container list

criteria.criterion: every other workstream can build against these docs without asking
criteria.test_method: inspect docs/architecture.md contract index; verify every referenced contract file exists and is non-trivial

criteria.criterion: each open spec question has an answer with rationale
criteria.test_method: parse docs/architecture.md §8; require each R1..R13 to carry an Answer and a Rationale

criteria.criterion: a simulated node registers and gets a role
criteria.test_method: POST /v1/nodes/register (synthetic compute node) -> 201 + role=compute + ULID id + node_token; confirm via GET /nodes

criteria.criterion: telemetry-driven OOM triggers a real remediation command
criteria.test_method: check operator-loop process + operator tables; inject >=95%-RAM telemetry; poll for remediation/audit record

criteria.criterion: the prompt 'deploy 3 agents + 1 fast LLM' yields clamped specs

criteria.test_method: POST intents with out-of-range spec + structural violations; verify values never pass through unchanged

criteria.criterion: a fresh node registers with the controller in <5s
criteria.test_method: time the controller registration (same synthetic node as W2.1)

criteria.criterion: VMs on Node A and Node C share one CIDR
criteria.test_method: inspect guest instances inside Node A / Node C via LXD; compare IPv4 subnets

criteria.criterion: llama.cpp on Node C is reachable from Node A over HTTP
criteria.test_method: from Node A container: HTTP GET http://<node-c-ip>:8080/health

criteria.criterion: an Agent VM on Node A calls llama.cpp on Node C and completes a multi-turn task with streaming responses
criteria.test_method: check for agent VM on Node A; probe llama.cpp streaming chat-completions on Node C

criteria.criterion: the image boots with zero network downloads
criteria.test_method: inspect image/evidence/offline-load-proof.txt + models.lock.json; confirm running llama-server loads a local model path

criteria.criterion: the dashboard shows live node health + streaming AI logs
the web terminal opens a working shell on a node
criteria.test_method: WebSocket /terminal/v1/{node_id}; send echo marker; read PTY output

criteria.criterion: the SSH command string is shown and works
criteria.test_method: GET /v1/projects/{pid}/nodes/{nid}/ssh; parse string+fingerprint; login only if break-glass key present

criteria.criterion: both scenarios reproducibly trigger an AI remediation that lands in time
criteria.test_method: verify chaos scripts + operator CLI/playbooks + threshold triggers exist; live timed trigger exercised by SRE red-team

criteria.criterion: the timed dry run passes end-to-end
criteria.test_method: search for a committed timed dry-run pass/fail artifact
